Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp: velocity & entitlement coordination for Pioneer pilot

Hi Lena / VendCorp ops team —

Thanks again for confirming the pilot dates next week. Quick internal ask: we need to lock the temporary entitlement (rate bump) and the onramp timeline so our infra/product teams can provision and avoid mid-launch throttles. I attached a short forecast (pioneer_onramp_forecast_v1.xlsx) and the formal entitlement request PDF.

High-level asks from our side:
- Temporary ingress uplift: peak TPS target = 220 TPS for first 48 hours, then 90 TPS steady-state (see sheet).
- Duration: 72-hour window of elevated entitlement to cover canary + scale.
- Fallback model: confirm whether you can accept the smaller-latency model fallback (gpt-open-16k -> gpt-open-8k) in case of capacity pressure.
- Prefix caching: confirm if Pioneer uses long common prefixes (yes/no) — this affects KV cache sizing.
- Billing & PO: we need an amendment to the pilot SOW for the uplift (we'll send a DocuSign).

Internal asks to product/infra:
- Karthik: can you triage the entitlement numbers and confirm safe burst multiplier before Monday 9AM PT?
- David: can infra provision temporary capacity and a canary route that pins to the region us-west-2? ETA for provisioning?
- Marissa/Naomi: customer success + sales to confirm acceptance criteria and billing amendment timeline.

If we can get these confirmed by EOD Monday (2026-11-08), we can run the warmup on Tuesday and be live Wednesday.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0164

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendcorp.com>

Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onramp: velocity & entitlement coordination for Pioneer pilot

Priya — thanks for the clear notes and attachments. Quick answers from our ops side:
- We can aim for the 220 TPS peak for the 48 hour period; our engineering lead asks that we have at least a 1.5x safety margin on requests-per-second over typical expected traffic — so if you recommend any other guardrails please flag.
- Fallback model: acceptable as long as output quality delta is called out (we'll run a short A/B on Tuesday morning).
- Prefix caching: Pioneer does have repeated system prompts (long prefixes) in 70% of requests.
- Billing/PO: I'll confirm with procurement and expect to sign the amendment by Thursday 2026-11-11.

We are scheduled for the customer demo on Wednesday 2026-11-10 11:00 AM PT. Ops would like a final traffic plan and canary checklist by EOD Tuesday.

Lena
Operations Lead, VendCorp
Lena.O@vendcorp.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: velocity & entitlement coordination for Pioneer pilot

Priya / team — reviewed the forecast and did a quick capacity check with infra. Notes below: 

1) Entitlement numbers
- Approve temporary entitlement: 220 TPS peak (48h), 90 TPS after.
- We'll request a soft cap at 300 TPS as an emergency ceiling; infra will throttle at cap and send alerts.

2) Product asks / safety knobs
- Model fallback: we can enable automatic fallback to gpt-open-8k with a header flag; product will annotate responses with a model tag so VendCorp can track quality drift.
- Cache settings: since Pioneer uses long prefixes, enable aggressive prefix KV caching for this account (cache TTL 10m) — this reduces token cost and latency.
- Batching: recommend a small client-side batching window of 25ms for bursts; will provide suggested SDK snippet today.

3) Roadmap/risks
- If peak traffic sustains >72 hours, we'll need to convert the uplift to a reserved capacity commit (pricing team will circle back).
- Telemetry: enable per-route token-level tracing for VendCorp during the window so we can diagnose regressions quickly.

Action items:
- David: can you provision the canary route + temp entitlement in us-west-2? ETA: Tue 14:00 PT.
- Marissa: coordinate the customer acceptance checklist and confirm whether we need SLA addendum.
- Naomi: please prepare the usage dashboard and set up a Slack channel with VendCorp ops.

I'll attach a short snippet in a follow-up with the SDK changes.

Karthik
Director, Product Operations
karthik@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: velocity & entitlement coordination for Pioneer pilot

Team — scheduling note and a couple of infra constraints: 

- Provisioning: I can provision the canary route and temp entitlement by Tue 2026-11-10 14:00 PT (meeting internal SLA). I will provision a regional pool and the routing policy to prefer us-west-2, with automatic fallback to us-east-1 if utilization > 75%.
- Monitoring/logging: we'll enable per-token tracing and a short retention window (48h) tied to this entitlement. Security asked we do not retain raw user prompts outside audit windows — we'll provide aggregated metrics and trace ids for debugging.
- Billing: finance needs a signed amendment before we flip the uplift. If VendCorp cannot sign by Thu 2026-11-11, we provision but keep uplift disabled until we have a signed amendment.

Attachments: temp_entitlement_request_DEAL-9482.pdf (submitted to finance), provisioning_runbook_snapshot.txt (runbook excerpt)

On the fallback + cache: cache config will be account-level; I'll scope it to Pioneer only. If VendCorp confirms long prefixes, we'll enable aggressive TTL immediately.

-David

- Fallback model enabled: gpt-open-8k with model tags in responses.
